verdict.rationale: Vapi's own docs show SIP ingress: any SIP client or softphone can dial a SIP URI to reach a Vapi assistant, so non-bundled SIP connectivity exists. The evidence covers only testing calls from softphones, not configuring a carrier or PBX trunk or porting or importing numbers. missing for 10: documented SIP trunk configuration for a carrier or PBX (inbound and outbound), Twilio/Telnyx number import, credentials and auth setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: This guide shows you how to set up and test SIP calls to your Vapi assistant using any SIP client or softphone.
Use any SIP softphone (e.g., Zoiper, Linphone) to dial your SIP URI
Make and test SIP calls to a Vapi assistant from any SIP client or softphone
